# Cdr Platform

CDR Platform provides an API for purchasing carbon dioxide removal services.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cdr-platform/.

## Actions

- **Get CDR Price** (read-only): Retrieve the cost of carbon dioxide removal.
- **Get Health Check** (read-only): Perform a health check of the cdr platform service.
- **Get Pricing and Billing Info** (read-only): Get current pricing, fees, and billing thresholds for carbon removal.
- **Post CDR Purchase**: Initiate the purchase of carbon dioxide removal credits.
